title: Finestkind Inc
specs: Traditional Maine wooden vessels maintained to high safety standards
Trips offer views of harbor seals, lobstering, Nubble Lighthouse, and coastal scenery
Children age 3-11 pay child rate; ages 2 and under free but must reserve space
No age minimum stated for adults
Life jackets available for emergency use; guests may bring own if desired
Private trips available if no other tickets sold for that departure
includes: Hot coffee, orange juice, and freshly baked muffin on breakfast cruise
Cash bar on Nubble Lighthouse and Cocktail cruises
gap: Maximum weight or health restrictions not stated
blurb: Guests take narrated boat trips along the Ogunquit shoreline to see harbor seals, lobstering in action, the Nubble Lighthouse, and enjoy cocktail or sailing cruises. Trips vary in length from 50 minutes to 1 ¾ hours and include a breakfast cruise with refreshments. The fleet consists of traditional Maine wooden vessels maintained to high safety standards.
extraNote: 24-hour cancellation policy for full refund; full refund if operator cancels; no refund for no-shows or late arrivals · Trips may be rescheduled or canceled due to weather; call ahead to confirm · Ticket booth under a large umbrella in front of Barnacle Billy’s patio in Perkins Cove; boarding through Barnacle Billy’s patio onto the dock. · May 1 through mid-October
